{{Quote|It is a decision I do not take lightly. Any incursion into Imperial space is fraught with the gravest of danger for every brave soldier who fights in our name. But there is a humanitarian crisis of the highest order on Ziost that demands our attention. When Imperial troops indiscriminately fire upon indentured slaves and helpless civilians, we cannot stand idly by. Those who cannot defend themselves&mdash;who have done no wrong yet find themselves under the thumb of the oppressive Sith Empire&mdash;must not be left to suffer. Someone must fight for them.|An excerpt from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]]'s address|<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Invasion of Ziost}}</ref>}}
The '''Invasion of Ziost''' was a military operation in [[3636 BBY]] during the [[Galactic War]], commenced by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] of the the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on an Imperial world of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], during [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]]'s [[Ziost crisis|manifestation]] on the planet.

== Prelude ==
In the aftermath of his [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|reawakening]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]] took gradual control of Ziost's population and used them to slaughter each other to fuel his strength. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] deployed the [[Sixth Line]]&mdash;a covert team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;to investigate, only for them to fall under Vitiate's control.<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" />

== Invasion ==
{{Quote|Our ships are in orbit. The invasion's already begun.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]|<ref name="powerless" />}}
As the [[Ziost crisis|situation]] worsened, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]] decided to ignore the warnings of [[Theron Shan]] and her agent [[Rane Kovach]], also stationed on the [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], and sent the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to exploit the Empire's weakness.<ref name="powerless" /> To justify the invasion, she claimed that the true reason for the operation is to deal with the "humanitarian crisis" on the planet.<ref name="codex" /> 

[[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] engaged the fleet of [[Darth Marr]] in orbit of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]],<ref name="dead center">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Dead Center|[[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]}}</ref> and [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]] contacted [[Theron Shan]], expecting his cooperation in taking over [[New Adasta]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet. Not knowing that the invasion had already begun, Theron once again tried to warn Saresh against committing her forces.<ref name="powerless" />

Landed Republic soldiers fell under [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]'s control just as the Imperials had, adding to his ever-growing army of [[Possession/Legends|possessed]]. Theron and [[Minister of Sith Intelligence|Sith Intelligence Minister]] [[Lana Beniko]] worked to free the planet's population from Vitiate using an powerful [[electrostatic gun]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Adasta]], but the effects were temporary and only a fraction of the planet's population was evacuated away from Vitiate's influence, before he unleashed a wave of [[Force drain/Legends|death energy]] across the planet, turning all living things, including still stationed Republic soldiers, to ash.<ref name="The End of It All" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Ziost first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the content added in Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor. Details of the invasion differ slightly between factions, and the fate of Agent Kovach is decided by the player.
